messages:
Marta (Partnerships): Heads up — Sapphire SI (Kaleido Health) hit a staging blocker during marketplace install. Init containers failing on egress to our artifact server, looks like netpolicy deny. Can we do a quick arch review + escalate to field-eng?

Raj Patel (Solutions): On it. Can you paste the error lines / pod logs? Is this during image pull or runtime?

Marta (Partnerships): Logs attached from their run: `connection refused` to `artifacts.redwood-inference.com:443` from `init-updater` pod. Image was pulled earlier, so runtime connectivity. Customer says no outbound egress allowed by default.

Sam Cho (Eng-Platform): Likely netpol in the tenant namespace blocking egress to external IPs. Two quick options: 1) add explicit egress CIDR to allow artifacts host, or 2) proxy via internal update service. Which route for SI?

Emma Li (Eng-Infra): For a fast unblock we can add a temporary egress rule for `artifacts.redwood-inference.com -> 54.23.12.19/32` and lock to port 443. Sam — is there a one-liner to fetch the pod logs we can give them?

Sam Cho (Eng-Platform): `kubectl -n sapphire-staging logs -l app=init-updater --tail=200` should surface the TLS handshake errors. Also check `kubectl -n sapphire-staging get networkpolicy -o yaml` to see current rules.

Marta (Partnerships): Thanks. I've asked the SI to run those and paste results here. Also, can infra prepare a short rollback-safe temp rule we can push? We want minimal blast radius.

devops-bot: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/marketplace-onboard#egress-workaround (last updated 2025-02-10)

Raj Patel (Solutions): I'll draft the temporary NetworkPolicy snippet for them to apply; will include explicit IP + port and a TTL annotation for auto-remove. Snippet:

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-artifacts-temp
  annotations:
    runbook/redwood-ttl: "3600" # auto remove after 1h
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: init-updater
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 54.23.12.19/32
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

Emma Li (Eng-Infra): That works. I'll review for permissioning concerns and prep a staged apply via our staging-runbook; will wait for SI confirmation before pushing.

Marta (Partnerships): Can we also loop in on-call field-eng? @Sam can you ping the field-eng rotation and book a 20m sync w/ SI + customer? Prefer 11:30 PT today if available.

Sam Cho (Eng-Platform): Pinged @field-eng-oncall. I can join at 11:30 PT. Raj and Emma?

Raj Patel (Solutions): I'm available 11:30 PT, will join and help drive the snippet application and rollback plan. :thumbsup:

Emma Li (Eng-Infra): I can make 11:30 PT. I'll have the staging apply ready to go in case we need it.

Marta (Partnerships): Awesome — I'll notify the SI and Kaleido. Opening escalation ticket RDW-1329 and flagging as P0 for delivery team. Will paste ticket link when created. Thanks everyone. :pray:
